# Rate floors and gear caps in closed pens (first generated by gen_floors.py, now lost; edited by hand since:
# gear built from parts with /gear since 11-05: a flint (macuahuitl) sword and leather armour, wrought iron, diamond).
# Floors (notes/PROGRESSION.md, the balance model): a large animal at least 10 s, a huge one about 45-50 s.
# 11-22, after the Weft sync: `/tk attr_mod` takes a step name (core:add), not an op number.
loaded
idle
chat /rule core:mob_spawning 0
chat /tk mode survival
chat /time set 6000
chat /tk attr_mod me core:entity_reach testkit:reach core:add 3 0
chat /tk attr_mod me core:max_health testkit:hp core:add 200 0
